description.value: Cactus Club Cafe's Bentall 5 location is a polished downtown Vancouver outpost of a well-established BC chain, offering chef-driven international cuisine in an upbeat, stylish room. The restaurant features both indoor and patio seating and operates a full pickup and delivery service. As a high-traffic anchor in the Burrard Street office and retail corridor, it draws a broad mix of business and leisure diners.
